messages:
anya (People Ops): Heads up: launching a short Mandatory Policy Refresher covering benefits eligibility updates and code of conduct refresh. Completion due Fri May 2. It's a 10-min micro-module + 2 quiz Qs.

saira (HRBP): Link + tracker: https://tiny.redwood/policy-refresher-2026. Managers: please add all direct reports and contractors to the tracker.

tess (Recruiting): For candidates in final-stage offer lanes, do new hires need to complete this before start date?

anya (People Ops): New hires should complete within first 14 days. We won't block start dates, but benefits enrollment window ties to completion for certain roles.

marco (Eng Manager): Any change to parental leave policy in this refresher? I thought that was part of the handbook update last quarter.

saira (HRBP): No material policy change to parental leave in this micro-module. It highlights recent clarifications to benefits eligibility for part-time employees and contractors. Full handbook changelog is linked in the tracker.

nisha (HRIS): Can ops-bot drop an export after the run so I can sync to payroll?

ops-bot: Export scheduled: /internal/hr/exports/policy_refresher_2026-05-02.csv next run 2026-05-02T03:00Z :robot_face:

anya (People Ops): Also note: handbook PR #501 adds a short FAQ about contractor benefits eligibility and the hiring checklist. Review welcome. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/handbook/pulls/501

marco (Eng Manager): I'm adding a note to our hiring checklist to flag contractor eligibility early.

tess (Recruiting): Please share the exact wording to add to the offer email re benefits enrollment timeline.

anya (People Ops): Template for offer email insert: "Please complete the Redwood Policy Refresher within your first 14 days; benefits enrollment deadlines are described in the onboarding portal. Contact benefits@redwood.com for questions."

nisha (HRIS): After the CSV run I'll produce a reconciliation report and tag managers for missing completions on 2026-05-03.

anya (People Ops): Manager reminder nudge scheduled for 2026-04-25. If you want custom text, post here.

marco (Eng Manager): Template looks fine, thanks.

tess (Recruiting): Noted; will update offer templates after PR merge.

anya (People Ops): Thanks folks — I'll post a brief status update mid-cycle and follow up on exceptions.
